## AS IS — Current state

### Runtime and language

- **Language**: PHP 8.4 (`composer.json` `"php": "^8.4"`; `.github/workflows/tests.yml` pins `php-version: '8.4'`) + TypeScript 5.2 (`package.json` `"typescript": "^5.2.2"`)
- **Framework**: Laravel 13 (`composer.json` `"laravel/framework": "^13.0"`) with Inertia v3 server adapter (`inertiajs/inertia-laravel ^3.0`) and Vue 3.5 client (`@inertiajs/vue3 ^3.0.0`, `vue ^3.5.13`)

### Drivers and defaults

| Setting | Dev default (`.env.example`) | Test override (`phpunit.xml`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DB_CONNECTION` | `mysql` | `sqlite` (`:memory:`) |
| `SESSION_DRIVER` | `database` | `array` |
| `CACHE_STORE` | `database` | `array` |
| `QUEUE_CONNECTION` | `database` | `sync` |
| `BROADCAST_CONNECTION` | `log` | `null` |
| `MAIL_MAILER` | `log` | `array` |
| `FILESYSTEM_DISK` | `local` | — |

`QUEUE_CONNECTION=database` and `database/migrations/0001_01_01_000002_create_jobs_table.php` are framework defaults only — nothing dispatches a job, no queued listener, no scheduler entry.

### Quality toolchain

| Tool | Version | Config | Command |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Laravel Pint | `^1.27` | `pint.json` — `{"preset": "laravel"}` | `composer lint` / `composer lint:check` (`pint --parallel [--test]`) |
| Larastan/PHPStan | `^3.9` | `phpstan.neon` — `level: 7`, paths `app/ bootstrap/app.php config/ database/ routes/`, no baseline, no `ignoreErrors` | `composer types:check` |
| ESLint 9 flat config | `^9.17.0` | `eslint.config.js` — `vue/flat/essential`, `vueTsConfigs.recommended`, `@stylistic`, `eslint-plugin-import` ordering, `eslint-config-prettier` | `npm run lint` / `npm run lint:check` |
| Prettier | `^3.4.2` | `.prettierrc` — 4-space, single quotes, printWidth 80, `prettier-plugin-tailwindcss` with `tailwindFunctions: clsx, cn, cva` | `npm run format` / `npm run format:check` |
| vue-tsc | `^2.2.4` | `tsconfig.json` | `npm run types:check` (`vue-tsc --noEmit`) |
| EditorConfig | — | `.editorconfig` — LF, 4-space, final newline, trim trailing (2-space for YAML) | editor-enforced |

Full gate: `composer ci:check` chains `npm run lint:check`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run types:check`, `npm run test`, then `composer test` (which itself runs `config:clear`, `lint:check`, `types:check`, `php artisan test`). `.github/workflows/tests.yml` runs exactly that after `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force`.

### Tests

| Role | Tool | Version | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PHP runner | Pest (+ `pest-plugin-laravel`, `pest-plugin-drift`) | `^5.1` / `^5.0` | `composer.json` require-dev; `tests/Pest.php` |
| PHP suites | PHPUnit XML config declaring `Unit` + `Feature` | — | `phpunit.xml` |
| PHP assertions | Pest `expect()` (custom `toBeOne`) + `Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia` | — | `tests/Pest.php`; `tests/Feature/Sessions/BoardPageTest.php` |
| PHP mocks / fixtures | `mockery/mockery`, `fakerphp/faker`, 14 model factories | `^1.6` / `^1.24` | `composer.json`; `database/factories/` |
| DB isolation | `RefreshDatabase` applied to all of `Feature` | — | `tests/Pest.php` `pest()->extend(TestCase::class)->use(RefreshDatabase::class)->in('Feature')` |
| JS runner | Vitest | `^4.1.11` | `vitest.config.ts` — `environment: 'node'`, includes `resources/js/{canvas,prancheta}/**/*.test.ts`, `@` alias to `resources/js` |
| Coverage | none configured | — | no coverage script in `composer.json`/`package.json`; `.github/workflows/tests.yml` sets `coverage: none` |

Notable: `tests/Feature/Frontend/*Test.php` are PHP tests that read `resources/js/**` as text (`frontendSource()`, `canvasFiles()`, `canvasTestNames()`) to assert frontend invariants — e.g. `CanvasEngineTest.php` fails if any `canvas/` file contains `from 'vue'`, `from '@inertiajs`, `document.` or `window.`. Editing TS/CSS can turn the PHP suite red. The catalog seed is not global: tests hitting `/prancheta` must call `seedCatalog()` (`tests/Pest.php`).

### External integrations

| System | Client wiring |
| --- | --- |
| MySQL 8 | `config/database.php` + `.env` `DB_*`; `docker-compose.yml` service `mysql:8.0` |
| Fortify auth (login, register, verify, 2FA, passkeys) | `config/fortify.php` `features` array; `app/Actions/Fortify/CreateNewUser.php`; `app/Http/Responses/LogoutResponse.php` |
| WebAuthn | `@laravel/passkeys ^0.2.0` + `routes/settings.php` `.well-known/passkey-endpoints` |
| Mail | `MAIL_MAILER=log`; consumed only by Fortify email verification |
| Laravel Boost MCP (dev tooling) | `laravel/boost ^2.5`, `.mcp.json` running `php artisan boost:mcp`, `boost.json` (`sail: false`) |
